claim_1.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MCV4 n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.

claim_2.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MCV4 n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that the polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody response against serogroups A and C peaked at day 30 compared to days 0, 7, 180 and 750.

sources.quote: These responses peaked at day 30 (MCV4) or day 180 (MPSV4) (Fig. 1a).
Antibody responses of meningococcal vaccinees. Serogroups A and C were measured for total IgG (a), IgG1 and IgG2 (b), IgM (c) and SBA titers (d).

Antibody responses of meningococcal vaccinees. Serogroups A and C were measured for total IgG (a), IgG1 and IgG2 (b), IgM (c) and SBA titers (d).

sources.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not (Fig. 1e).
(e) A strong IgG response against diphtheria toxoid was detected in MCV4 vaccinees.

sources.quote: The ASCs showed a peak at day 7 in both vaccines (Fig. 1f).
(f) Antibody secreting cells (ASCs, selected as CD3− CD20− CD38hi CD27hi CD19+ cells)

sources.quote: Indeed, the percentage of total ASCs in the blood at day 7 after MCV4 vaccination strongly correlated with the serum anti-DT IgG (Fig. 1g), and not with the anti-polysaccharide IgG response (data not shown).
(g) the number of ASCs at day 7 correlated with diphtheria toxoid-specific serum IgG at day 7.

claim_25.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MCV4 n=17) at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed 1,150 differentially expressed genes at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: At day 7 post-vaccination, we identified 1,150 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in MCV4 vaccinees (Fig. 2a).

Differential expression analysis was performed using paired t-test for each vaccine and each time point (day 3 or day 7 compared to baseline). The red dots in volcano plots show differentially expressed genes (DEGs, p < 0.001), with the numbers of DEGs.

claim_26.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MCV4 n=17) at day 7 post-vaccination showed that the differentially expressed genes bore the hallmark of antibody secreting cells compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: These DEGs bear the hallmark of antibody secreting cells (ASC), which is consistent with the enhanced frequencies of these cells (Fig. 1f).

claim_27.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MCV4 n=17) at day 7 post-vaccination, using blood transcription modules, showed that the XBP1 network was highly enriched for up-regulated genes compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: This XBP1 network is also highly enriched for up-regulated genes at day 7 post-MCV4 vaccination (Supplementary Fig. 2).

claim_28.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from healthy young adults (18–45 yr; MPSV4 n=13 and MCV4 n=17) at day 3 post-vaccination and MPSV4 at day 7 post-vaccination showed only a small number of differentially expressed genes compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: However, only a small number of DEGs were identified at day 3 post-vaccination for both MPSV4 and MCV4, and at day 7 for MPSV4 (Fig. 2a).

Differential expression analysis was performed using paired t-test for each vaccine and each time point (day 3 or day 7 compared to baseline). The red dots in volcano plots show differentially expressed genes (DEGs, p < 0.001), with the numbers of DEGs.

claim_29.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees at day 7 post-vaccination showed that several B cell genes, including TNFRSF17, were up-regulated in MCV4 and TIV vaccinees compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Several B cell genes were up-regulated at day 7 in MCV4 and TIV vaccinees (Fig. 3b), including TNFRSF17, a B cell differentiation gene that is predictive of antibody responses to the YF-17D and TIV vaccines 4, 6.
(b) Selected DEGs involved in B cell development and innate immunity.

claim_30.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees at day 3 post-vaccination showed that innate immunity and interferon response genes including OAS1, OAS2, STAT1, STAT2 and TRIM22 were up-regulated with live attenuated virus vaccines compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Genes associated with innate immunity and interferon responses, such as OAS1, OAS2, STAT1, STAT2 and TRIM22 were up-regulated at day 3 post-vaccination with live attenuated virus vaccines (Fig. 3b).
(b) Selected DEGs involved in B cell development and innate immunity.

claim_31.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees, using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, showed that several pathways related to cell proliferation were significantly induced by different vaccines compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Several pathways related to cell proliferation (ERBB1 downstream signaling, CDC42 signaling, E2F network, c-myc targets) were significantly induced by different vaccines, as well as innate pathways including interferon gamma pathway in YF-17D, mTOR pathway and TNFR signaling in MPSV4 and PDGFR-β signaling in YF-17D, MCV4 and MPSV4 (Supplementary Fig. 5).

claim_32.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees, using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, showed that the interferon gamma pathway in YF-17D, the mTOR pathway and TNFR signaling in MPSV4, and PDGFR-β signaling in YF-17D, MCV4 and MPSV4 were significantly induced compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Several pathways related to cell proliferation (ERBB1 downstream signaling, CDC42 signaling, E2F network, c-myc targets) were significantly induced by different vaccines, as well as innate pathways including interferon gamma pathway in YF-17D, mTOR pathway and TNFR signaling in MPSV4 and PDGFR-β signaling in YF-17D, MCV4 and MPSV4 (Supplementary Fig. 5).

claim_33.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees, using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, showed that BCR signaling pathway expression was positively associated with antibody responses in TIV and MCV4.

sources.quote: We also identified pathways whose expression were correlated to antibody responses (Supplementary Fig. 6), such as “BCR signaling pathway” for TIV and MCV4 and “ATF-2 transcription factor network” for YF-17D.

claim_34.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees, using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, showed that ATF-2 transcription factor network expression was positively associated with antibody responses in YF-17D.

sources.quote: We also identified pathways whose expression were correlated to antibody responses (Supplementary Fig. 6), such as “BCR signaling pathway” for TIV and MCV4 and “ATF-2 transcription factor network” for YF-17D.

claim_35.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that early day 3 correlation profiles formed three distinctive patterns representing the protein recall response shared by TIV and MCV4 anti-DT, the polysaccharide response shared by MPSV4 and MCV4 anti-PS, and the primary viral response in YF-17D compared to the other vaccine response patterns.

sources.quote: Yet to our surprise, the early BTM correlation profiles at day 3 displayed three distinctive patterns (Fig. 5a and Supplementary Fig. 11) that represent the protein recall response (shared by TIV and MCV4 anti-DT), the polysaccharide response (shared by MPSV4 and MCV4 anti-PS) and primary the viral response (YF-17D).
BTM analysis reveals distinct mechanisms of antibody response. (a) Each vaccine data set is shown as one of six segments on the circular plot.

claim_36.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from YF-17D vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that higher antibody response was positively associated with greater activity in interferon response and cell adhesion modules at day 3.

sources.quote: In the primary viral response (Fig. 5a, b, Supplementary Fig. 12), higher antibody response is associated with greater activity in interferon response and cell adhesion modules.
(b) Illustration of module activity. The heat map on the right shows the Pearson correlation between module activity and antibody response in each study.

claim_37.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from YF-17D vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that antibody response was negatively associated with cell division modules including PLK1 signaling events at day 3.

sources.quote: Inversely correlated to the antibody response are a number of cell division modules, including PLK1 signaling events.

claim_38.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that day 3 anti-polysaccharide antibody responses were positively associated with modules linked to antigen presenting cells and their activation, complement, and proinflammatory cytokines.

sources.quote: The anti-polysaccharide response at day 3 (Fig. 5a, top; Supplementary Fig. 12) contains a number of modules associated with antigen presenting cells and their activation, as well as complement and proinflammatory cytokines (Fig. 5b).
(b) Illustration of module activity. The heat map on the right shows the Pearson correlation between module activity and antibody response in each study.

claim_39.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that anti-polysaccharide IgG responses were positively associated with the dendritic cell surface signature module.

sources.quote: The correlation of DC surface signature module to anti-polysaccharide IgG in both MCV4 and MPSV4 is shown (Supplementary Fig. 14b).

claim_40.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of human myeloid DC and monocyte derived DC from human PBMC showed that MPSV4 induced up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules CD80, CD83, HLA-DR and CD86 and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 compared to unstimulated cells.

sources.quote: Up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 was detected in human DCs stimulated by MPSV4 (Fig. 6a).

The meningococcal polysaccharide vaccine activates myeloid dendritic cells. (a) Induction of cytokines by MPSV4 from human myeloid DC (4 independent replicates) and monocyte derived DC (6 independent replicates). Mean values of independent replicates are shown, error bars as s.e.m. Secreted IL-6 protein levels are shown but the same result was observed for TNF and IL-12p40 levels.

claim_41.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of mouse splenic CD11c+ DCs stimulated in vitro showed that MPSV4-induced dendritic cell maturation was dependent on Myd88, Trif, Tlr4 and Asc compared to wild-type cells.

sources.quote: Using these cells from the appropriate knockout mice, we demonstrated that DC maturation induced by MPSV4 is dependent on Myd88, Trif and Tlr4, as well as inflammasome activation (Fig. 6b, Supplementary Fig. 16).
(b) Mouse knockout DCs show that the MPSV4 stimulation is dependent on Myd88, Trif, Tlr4 and Asc in vitro.

claim_42.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of human myeloid DC and monocyte derived DC from human PBMC showed that MCV4 did not induce robust activation of dendritic cells in vitro compared to MPSV4 stimulation.

sources.quote: However, despite there being a correlation of the DC surface signature module to anti-polysaccharide IgG (Supplementary Figure 14b), MCV4 did not induce robust activation of DCs in vitro (Fig. 6a & Supplementary Fig. 16).

The meningococcal polysaccharide vaccine activates myeloid dendritic cells. (a) Induction of cytokines by MPSV4 from human myeloid DC (4 independent replicates) and monocyte derived DC (6 independent replicates).

claim_43.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from TIV and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that day 3 module activity was positively associated with hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers in TIV and diphtheria toxoid-specific antibody titers in MCV4 through a transcriptomic program with monocyte features, especially Toll-like receptor signaling.

sources.quote: The modules whose activity on day 3 correlate with HAI titers (TIV) and the DT-specific antibody titers (MCV4) are likely be part of a transcriptomic program associated with protein recall responses (Fig. 5a, lower right; Supplementary Fig. 12). This program displays many monocyte features, especially of Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling.
(b) Illustration of module activity. The heat map on the right shows the Pearson correlation between module activity and antibody response in each study.

claim_44.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from TIV and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that day 7 plasma and memory B cell modules were positively associated with antibody responses compared to lower module activity.

sources.quote: Plasma and memory B cell modules at day 7 are indeed positively correlated with the antibody response in both vaccines (Supplementary Fig. 18).

claim_45.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from YF-17D, TIV, MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that T cell activation was negatively associated with antibody responses in MPSV4 at day 7 and in TIV at days 3 and 7.

sources.quote: For instance, T cell activation appears to be negatively correlated with antibody responses in MPSV4 (D7) and TIV (D3 and D7), consistent with our previous report 6.

claim_46.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMC from YF-17D, TIV, MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription modules, showed that the male-specific module M240 was negatively associated with antibody response across these vaccines.

sources.quote: A male-specific module (M240) is negatively correlated to antibody response in all these vaccines with varying statistical significance, suggesting a gender bias in antibody production.
